payload.text: The permitted record supplies two attributed statements. Mira describes Fictional Rowan handing a blue token to Fictional Ellis at the desk (E-001). Tavi describes Fictional Ellis standing at the desk and Fictional Rowan departing with the token still in hand (E-002); Tavi's stated non-observation of a handover does not establish that none occurred. Both accounts are attributed and disputed, not independently established findings. The Crown rests on the permitted sources and asks you to apply the beyond-a-reasonable-doubt burden.

The Defence notes the Crown's acknowledgement that both accounts are attributed and disputed, not independently established findings (E-001; E-002). E-002 records Tavi's stated observation that Fictional Ellis stood at the desk while Fictional Rowan departed with the blue token still in hand, with Tavi stating: "I did not see a handover." On this supplied record, the disputed accounts do not establish receipt beyond a reasonable doubt.
